mapper.sql: A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.ACCT_ID AS acctId , A.VICTIM_USER_TYPE_CD AS victimUserTypeCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', A.VICTIM_USER_TYPE_CD, 'SYS050') AS victimUserTypeNm , A.VICTIM_USER_CD AS victimUserCd , CASE WHEN VU.VU_NM IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(VU.VU_NM) <= 1 THEN VU.VU_NM WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(VU.VU_NM) = 2 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(VU.VU_NM, 1), '*') ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(VU.VU_NM, 2), REPEAT('*', CHAR_LENGTH(VU.VU_NM) - 2)) END AS victimUserNm , VU.VU_LAST4 AS victimMblNoLast4 , A.OCCUR_YMD AS occurYmd , A.OCCUR_TIME AS occurTime , A.OCCUR_PLACE AS occurPlace , A.ACCT_GRADE_CD AS acctGradeCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', A.ACCT_GRADE_CD, 'SYS065') AS acctGradeNm , A.ACCT_DESC AS acctDesc , A.EMPLOYER_DESC AS employerDesc , A.PROCESS_STATUS_CD AS processStatusCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', A.PROCESS_STATUS_CD, 'SYS066') AS processStatusNm , A.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate , A.UPDATE_NO AS updateNo , DATE_FORMAT(A.UPDATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updateDate

LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER RU ON ( A.VICTIM_USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' AND A.CMPNY_CD = RU.CMPNY_CD AND A.VICTIM_USER_CD = RU.USER_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_USER DU ON ( A.VICTIM_USER_TYPE_CD = 'DAILY' AND A.CMPNY_CD = DU.CMPNY_CD AND A.VICTIM_USER_CD = DU.USER_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN A.VICTIM_USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' THEN RU.USER_NM ELSE DU.USER_NM END AS VU_NM , CASE WHEN A.VICTIM_USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' THEN RU.MBL_NO_LAST4 ELSE DU.MBL_NO_LAST4 END AS VU_LAST4 ) VU ON TRUE
mapper.select: /* Acct01Mapper.selectAttendanceSchedule */ SELECT WP.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , WP.WORK_PLAN_CD AS workPlanCd , SM.SCH_CD AS schCd , SM.SCH_TYPE AS schType , SM.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS fstSchStrTime , SM.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS fstSchEndTime , SM.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS secSchStrTime , SM.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS secSchEndTime FROM TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT SM ON ( WP.CMPNY_CD = SM.CMPNY_CD AND WP.SITE_CD = SM.SITE_CD AND WP.WORK_PLAN_CD = SM.SCH_CD ) WHERE WP.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND WP.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND WP.USER_CD = #{victimUserCd} AND WP.WORK_YMD = #{occurYmd} LIMIT 1

/* Acct01Mapper.selectAttendanceRecords */ SELECT A.ATTD_ID AS attdId , A.USER_CD AS userCd , A.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , A.WORK_SEQ AS workSeq , A.CHECK_IN_DATE AS checkInDate , A.CHECK_IN_TIME AS checkInTime , A.CHECK_OUT_DATE AS checkOutDate , A.CHECK_OUT_TIME AS checkOutTime FROM TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{victimUserCd} AND A.WORK_YMD = #{occurYmd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY A.WORK_SEQ

/* Acct01Mapper.selectRiskAssessmentDetailForPrint */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.PROCESS_CD AS processCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'BAIM_VAL', A.PROCESS_CD, 'COM002') AS processNm , A.RISK_TYPE_CD AS riskTypeCd , RT.RISK_TYPE_NM AS riskTypeNm , A.HAZARD_CD AS hazardCd , CASE WHEN A.HAZARD_CD = 'self' THEN A.ASSESSMENT_DESC ELSE SH.HAZARD_NM END AS hazardNm , A.ASSESSMENT_CD AS assessmentCd , A.ASSESSMENT_STATUS AS assessmentStatus , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', A.ASSESSMENT_STATUS, 'SYS011') AS assessmentStatusNm , A.INIT_LIKELIHOOD_SCORE AS initLikelihoodScore , A.INIT_SEVERITY_SCORE AS initSeverityScore , A.INIT_RISK_LV AS initRiskLv , A.INIT_DESC AS initDesc , A.INIT_ASSESSOR_ID AS initAssessorId , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.INIT_ASSESSOR_ID, NULL) AS initAssessorNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INIT_ASSESS_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS initAssessDate , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_NAME', A.INIT_FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS initFileMgmtCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_PATH', A.INIT_FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS initFilePath , A.REVAL_DATE AS revalDate , A.REVAL_BEFORE_DESC AS revalBeforeDesc , A.REVAL_LIKELIHOOD_SCORE AS revalLikelihoodScore , A.REVAL_SEVERITY_SCORE AS revalSeverityScore , A.REVAL_RISK_LV AS revalRiskLv , A.REVAL_DESC AS revalDesc , A.REVAL_ASSESSOR_ID AS revalAssessorId , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.REVAL_ASSESSOR_ID, NULL) AS revalAssessorNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.REVAL_ASSESS_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS revalAssessDate , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_NAME', A.REVAL_FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS revalFileMgmtCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_PATH', A.REVAL_FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS revalFilePath FROM TB_RISK_ASSESSMENT A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_TYPE RT ON (A.CMPNY_CD = RT.CMPNY_CD AND A.RISK_TYPE_CD = RT.RISK_TYPE_CD) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_SITE_HAZARD SH ON (A.CMPNY_CD = SH.CMPNY_CD AND A.RISK_TYPE_CD = SH.RISK_TYPE_CD AND A.HAZARD_CD = SH.HAZARD_CD) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.ASSESSMENT_CD = #{assessmentCd}

/* Acct01Mapper.selectTbmList */ SELECT S.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.SITE_CD AS siteCd , S.TITLE AS title , S.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(S.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', S.STATUS_CD, 'SYS046') AS statusNm , S.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(S.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', S.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(S.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD AS victimCompletionStatusCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(S.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD, 'SYS053') AS victimCompletionStatusNm FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT ON ( S.CMPNY_CD = AT.CMPNY_CD AND S.SESSION_CD = AT.SESSION_CD AND AT.USER_CD = #{victimUserCd} AND AT.USER_TYPE_CD = #{victimUserTypeCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' ) WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND DATE(S.OPENED_AT) = STR_TO_DATE(#{occurYmd}, '%Y%m%d') ORDER BY S.OPENED_AT DESC, S.SESSION_CD DESC

/* Acct01Mapper.selectLegalStepList */ SELECT M.STEP_CD AS stepCd , M.ACCT_GRADE_CD AS acctGradeCd , M.STEP_IDX AS stepIdx , M.STEP_NM AS stepNm , M.ACTION_GUIDE AS actionGuide , M.LEGAL_BASIS AS legalBasis , M.DEADLINE_RULE_CD AS deadlineRuleCd , M.STEP_TYPE AS stepType , M.STEP_NOTE AS stepNote , IFNULL(S.IS_DONE_YN, 'N') AS isDoneYn , DATE_FORMAT(S.DONE_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS doneDtime , S.DONE_USER_CD AS doneUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(#{gvCmpnyCd}, 'USER_NM', S.DONE_USER_CD, NULL) AS doneUserNm , S.REMARK AS remark FROM TB_ACCT_LEGAL_STEP_MASTER M LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ACCT_LEGAL_STEP S ON ( S.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND S.ACCT_ID = #{acctId} AND S.STEP_CD = M.STEP_CD ) WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (M.ACCT_GRADE_CD = #{acctGradeCd} OR M.ACCT_GRADE_CD = 'ALL') ORDER BY M.STEP_IDX, M.STEP_CD
mapper.insert:
/* Acct01Mapper.upsertLegalStep */ INSERT INTO TB_ACCT_LEGAL_STEP ( CMPNY_CD , SITE_CD , ACCT_ID , STEP_CD , IS_DONE_YN , DONE_DTIME , DONE_USER_CD , REMARK , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{gvCmpnyCd} , #{siteCd} , #{acctId} , #{stepCd} , IFNULL(#{isDoneYn}, 'N') , CASE WHEN #{isDoneYn} = 'Y' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END , CASE WHEN #{isDoneYn} = 'Y' THEN #{gvUserCd} ELSE NULL END , #{remark} , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
DONE_DTIME = CASE WHEN IFNULL(#{isDoneYn}, 'N') = 'Y' AND IS_DONE_YN = 'Y' THEN DONE_DTIME WHEN IFNULL(#{isDoneYn}, 'N') = 'Y' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END , DONE_USER_CD = CASE WHEN IFNULL(#{isDoneYn}, 'N') = 'Y' AND IS_DONE_YN = 'Y' THEN DONE_USER_CD WHEN IFNULL(#{isDoneYn}, 'N') = 'Y' THEN #{gvUserCd} ELSE NULL END , REMARK = #{remark} , UPDATE_NO = #{gvUserCd} , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() , IS_DONE_YN = IFNULL(#{isDoneYn}, 'N')
mapper.select: /* Acct01Mapper.selectLegalStepHistory */ SELECT S.STEP_CD AS stepCd , M.STEP_NM AS stepNm , DATE_FORMAT(S.DONE_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS doneDtime , S.DONE_USER_CD AS doneUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(S.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', S.DONE_USER_CD, NULL) AS doneUserNm , S.REMARK AS remark FROM TB_ACCT_LEGAL_STEP S LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ACCT_LEGAL_STEP_MASTER M ON (S.STEP_CD = M.STEP_CD) WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND S.ACCT_ID = #{acctId} AND S.IS_DONE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY S.DONE_DTIME DESC, M.STEP_IDX
